verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe several AI-generated insights over the user's own data. These include conversational queries to spot patterns or anomalies in transactions, AI-assisted explanations of how tax was calculated, discrepancy detection against ERP data with correction recommendations, and AI-ranked tax code suggestions with confidence levels, alongside the Avalara Avi Agent. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the in-product Avi Agent insight experience (versus MCP/API surfaces), and independent or hands-on corroboration that these insights work as described.
